items.title: Eddie Morris Interview, 1958-12-21
items.q: Oh yeah, you had the Razu Oh that was the best senator they ever had in the state I believe

ctx.x: And then uh...what did you say? You had the Razu?

Oh yeah, you had the Razu Oh that was the best senator they ever had in the state I believe He had everything out there and he'd come on Saturday night with one sack of money in each hand Silver money you know, that's to make everybody Razu for their money I used to get on off the stand and go Razu too for their money What does Razu mean? Throw up money you know, till you done emptied the sack No I am Throw the jails up in there on the floor And you know people used to come for that Gee whiz, they all would be…
And then after you worked for Senator Brady who did you play with?
